question: What does the G5 code (test/shiploop_e2e/quality.py, operator catalog js-1) say about the eight saved deliveries after the fix round, and does it reproduce the design's prototype?
how: scratch copies of the saved work folders (git ls-files, no .git); the harness's own quality.measure with the declarations of cases.json, including quality.refuse_ports [3000]; every child of the phase ran under test/shiploop_e2e/refuse_ports.cjs, which refuses listen and connect on :3000 and counts the refusals. The saved folders are only read. A watcher polled `lsof -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN` every 0.3 s during every run: no listener was seen (listeners_on_3000). SUPERSEDES the 2026-10-09 first evidence, whose 'starts no server on a fixed port' was false: the mutation phase itself listened on :3000 in five of the eight deliveries (the eq-flip of `require.main === module` and the logic-flip of `Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000`), see the port_refused marks below.
